title: Actual SU(2) conditional influence: a strong-coupling bound and a weak-coupling obstruction
status: Finite-cutoff progress and a precisely delimited obstruction. The physical mass gap and all twelve Clay requirements remain open.

normalization.group: SU(2), represented by unit quaternions q in R^4
normalization.action: S_beta(U) = beta sum_p (2 - Re Tr U_p), with unnormalized fundamental trace Tr(q)=2 Re(q)
normalization.staple_sum: A = sum of six actual exterior unit-quaternion staples; r = ||A|| <= 6
normalization.scalar_mean: m(kappa) = SU2HaarTilt.axisMean(kappa), the actual Haar expectation of q.re under exp(kappa q.re)
normalization.metric: Quaternion chord distance ||q-q_prime|| on each link. Infinitesimal subgroup speed agrees with the usual unit-sphere geodesic normalization. Uniform rescaling of all link metrics cancels in influence ratios.
normalization.operator_distinction: The Euclidean four-dimensional Wilson single-link heatbath is studied here. It is not the temporal Wilson slab Doob operator, its gauge-reduced version, or the reconstructed physical Hamiltonian.

new_certified_module.verification_scope: Lean-certified actual-Haar differential responses, quaternion metric bounds, and actual original-Wilson-law scalar lower estimates. No formal Dobrushin matrix or Wasserstein distance is defined in this module.
results: For differentiable A(t), A(t0) nonzero and <A(t0),B>=0, derivative E_{nu_A(t)}<q,B> at t0 equals m(2 beta ||A||)<A_prime,B>/||A||.

A(t)=(5+cos t)1+sin t I is a sum of five fixed unit staples and one genuine rotating unit staple. The probe I has norm one, its response derivative at zero is m(12 beta)/6, and the input chord displacement is at most |t|.
Every uniform local mean-response bound along that path has constant C >= m(12 beta)/6. For beta>3/16, 18 C>1.

For every unit B perpendicular to A, the exact affine-direction response is m(2 beta ||A||)/||A||. Its scalar lower proxy J_beta(A)=18 m(2 beta ||A||)/max(3,||A||) is continuous and nonnegative for beta>=0.

Under the actual interacting Wilson law, E J_beta(A_e) >= (3-3/(2 beta)) (1-P[||A_e||<=3]). This uses the real staple field and original Wilson measure, not an arbitrary marginal or assumed concentration estimate.
For every beta_i tending to infinity, every sequence/net of allowed lattice volumes and selected links, the explicit lower envelope tends to 3. The original-law expectation of J eventually exceeds 1.
new_certified_module.verification: PASS: source check and real scoped Lake build; no new warnings; ten principal axiom checks use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

eighteen_neighbor_geometry.verification_scope: Natural mathematics, checked directly against WilsonSingleLinkStaples.forwardStaple/backwardStaple. Not a new Lean lattice-count theorem.
eighteen_neighbor_geometry.lattice_condition: Periodic n^4 lattice, n>=3, selected positive link e=(x,mu).
disjointness_proof: Different transverse directions have different link directions except for the opposite parallel links.
The six opposite parallel-link bases x plus or minus e_nu are distinct for n>=3.
For fixed nu, the four nu-link bases differ in their mu and nu coordinates and are distinct already for n>=2.

Thus the three transverse directions give 3*6=18 distinct other links, each occurring in exactly one of the selected link’s six staples. The n>=3 restriction avoids the n=2 collision of opposite parallel links.
eighteen_neighbor_geometry.isometry: For fixed other links, a staple is obtained from its varied link by multiplication on either side and possibly inversion. All these maps are chord-metric isometries of the unit quaternions; their differentials map the link tangent isometrically onto the tangent v-perp of the affected unit staple.

worst_boundary_obstruction.verification_scope: Natural-math interpretation of certified scalar responses through the above actual lattice geometry and the Kantorovich dual lower bound. No physical gap nonexistence claim.
worst_boundary_obstruction.definition: c_ej = sup_{exteriors differing only at j} W1(nu_e(.|U),nu_e(.|U_prime)) / ||U_j-U_prime_j||. alpha_e = sum_{j!=e} c_ej.
aligned_construction: Set every exterior link to 1. All six staples equal 1, so A=6*1.
Change any one of the 18 neighbor links along exp(t I). Exactly one staple becomes exp(t I) or exp(-t I); use probe I or -I to remove the orientation sign.
The output probe is 1-Lipschitz, so any coupling gives W1 >= absolute change of that probe mean.
Taking t to zero and using the certified derivative and chord speed yields c_ej >= m(12 beta)/6.
Consequently alpha_e >= 3 m(12 beta) >= 3-3/(8 beta). In particular the ordinary unweighted row-sum Dobrushin condition fails for beta>3/16.
balanced_staples: A cancelling exterior is also available: set the transverse links in the six staples to 1 and choose the six distinct opposite parallel links to be three +1 and three -1. Then A=0.
The normalized conditional law is Haar and its coordinate covariance is exactly I/4. A unit tangent displacement of any one staple therefore has linear-probe response beta/2.

This gives the stronger natural-math lower bound alpha_e >= 9 beta, hence failure for beta>1/9. The actual smooth unit-link path version at A=0 uses ordinary differentiability of the compact Haar exponential integral; this particular lattice-path/W1 statement is not packaged as a Lean theorem here.
The aligned construction is independently useful because it avoids relying on rare cancelling exteriors.

The zero-staple derivative follows directly by uniform first-order Taylor expansion of exp(2 beta <q,A(t)>) on compact S^3: the denominator has zero first derivative, the Haar first moment is zero, and its covariance is I/4. Thus the response derivative is (beta/2) A_prime(0), without assuming a differentiability theorem about an unspecified effective action.
limits: Failure of this sufficient mixing criterion is not failure of uniqueness, a physical mass gap, or continuum existence.
The witnessing single-link linear probes are gauge variant. Gauge-invariant collective norms and cancellations are not ruled out.
No assertion is made about a choice of nonuniform link weights, multiscale block metrics, or a gauge-fixed quotient criterion without separate analysis.

annealed_obstruction.verification_scope: The scalar proxy and its original-law lower expectation are Lean-certified. Its domination by the complete local W1 differential row is natural mathematics, supplied below.
annealed_obstruction.local_coefficient: At fixed exterior U, define ell_linear_ej(U) as the supremum over unit imaginary-quaternion generators X and unit ambient vectors B of the absolute derivative of E_{nu_e}[<q,B>] when link j follows U_j exp(tX). This is a lower bound for the full local W1 differential influence.
pointwise_derivation: For any affected unit staple v and A!=0, the orthogonal complement of span(A,v) in R^4 has dimension at least two. Choose a unit D perpendicular to both.
Because D is tangent to the staple sphere at v, an actual unit-speed change of any one of its three constituent links realizes this staple derivative, by the isometry noted above.
The probe F_D(q)=<q,D> is 1-Lipschitz and perpendicular to A. The exact response is m(2 beta r)/r.
Hence each of the 18 local differential coefficients is at least m(2 beta r)/r. Their sum is at least 18 m(2 beta r)/r >= J_beta(A). At A=0, J_beta(0)=0 and the lower inequality is automatic.

Each linear coefficient is a maximum over the fixed compact parameter set S^2 x S^3 of a continuous covariance expression, 2 beta |Cov(<q,B>,<q,D_ej(U)X>)|. The actual staple differential D_ej(U) is continuous in the finitely many exterior links. Compact normalized Haar differentiation gives continuity of the covariance, and the maximum theorem gives continuity, hence measurability, of ell_linear_ej(U). Therefore the original-law expectation of the linear row is well defined and is at least E J_beta(A).
annealed_obstruction.actual_probability_input: WilsonBadStapleProbability.bad_probability_tendsto, derived from the actual energy cost and the proved Wilson entropy/free-energy bound, supplies P_beta(r<=3)->0 uniformly in changing volume.
annealed_obstruction.conclusion: The annealed row of absolute linear-probe differential influences has liminf at least 3 along beta->infinity. The full supremum-over-Lipschitz-probes row is no smaller. Replacing a supremum over exteriors by either of these original-law averages therefore cannot yield a contraction constant below 1.
annealed_obstruction.distinction: This does not bound the spectral radius of a signed/cancelled influence operator or the response of fixed gauge-invariant observables; the supremum over direction/probe is essential.

volume_independent_strong_coupling_estim.verification_scope: Self-contained natural-math derivation, not newly Lean-certified as a full Wasserstein/Dobrushin theorem.
derivation: For any probability law on the unit sphere and any chord-1-Lipschitz F, independent q,q_prime give Var(F)=(1/2)E(F(q)-F(q_prime))^2 <= (1/2)E||q-q_prime||^2 = 1-||E q||^2 <= 1.
For G_D(q)=<q,D>, Var(G_D)<=||D||^2. Compactness makes every Lipschitz probe bounded and justifies differentiating the normalized exponential integral.
For A_s=A+sD, d/ds E_{nu_A_s}F=2 beta Cov(F,G_D). Cauchy-Schwarz therefore gives an absolute derivative bound 2 beta ||D|| for beta>=0.

Integrating along the straight staple interpolation A_s=(1-s)A+sA_prime gives |E_nu_A F-E_nu_A_prime F|<=2 beta ||A-A_prime||. On this compact metric space Kantorovich duality gives W1(nu_A,nu_A_prime)<=2 beta ||A-A_prime||.

If one actual exterior neighbor link changes, exactly one staple changes and its chord distance equals that of the link. Thus c_ej<=2 beta; all non-neighbor coefficients vanish. For n>=3, alpha_e<=36 beta independently of volume.

In particular beta<1/36 gives a genuine volume-independent single-site Wasserstein Dobrushin influence bound alpha<1. Standard associated Lipschitz coupling/uniqueness estimates can then be applied; this calculation alone does not identify an L2 physical transfer gap.
volume_independent_strong_coupling_estim.why_not_physical: Every positive logarithmically growing weak-coupling branch beta(a) tends to infinity and eventually leaves this strong-coupling interval. A fixed-lattice strong-coupling mixing theorem cannot be analytically continued to that trajectory without new estimates.

all_lipschitz_good_region_derivation: Let u=A/r. For any chord-1-Lipschitz F, Var(F)<=E(F(q)-F(u))^2<=E||q-u||^2=2(1-m(2 beta r)).
Similarly Var(G_D)<=2(1-m(2 beta r))||D||^2. Thus |d E F/ds|<=4 beta (1-m)||D||<=3||D||/r, using the certified Gamma-derived mean concentration 1-m<=3/(4 beta r).
Combining this with the global 2 beta bound yields an infinitesimal scalar envelope min(2 beta,3/r). For the original Wilson exterior distribution, its mean is at most 3/r0+2 beta P(r<=r0).

The certified probability estimate is P(r<=r0)<=18 energyEnvelope(beta)/(6-r0), with energyEnvelope(beta)=1568/beta^2+(16/(3 beta))log(2 beta+5). Multiplication by beta leaves an O(log beta) bound on the bad contribution.

Even a separately established exponentially small bad-event probability would only remove that term. The remaining summed eighteen-neighbor upper envelope is 54/r0>9 for r0<6, and the proved lower-proxy argument shows an actual annealed absolute-row obstruction, rather than merely a loose upper estimate.
why_small_staple_upper_bounds_do_not_clo.important_transport_limit: This original-law estimate is for infinitesimal response. A finite exterior perturbation interpolates through other tilted exterior laws; the original-law probability bound cannot be applied to all those laws without an additional change-of-measure or stability estimate.

primary_literature_check.title: Shen, Zhu and Zhu: A stochastic analysis approach to lattice Yang-Mills at strong coupling
identifiers: Eq. (1.2), PDF p.4: action coefficient N beta_paper
primary_literature_check.verified_summary: The authors prove strong-coupling functional inequalities, uniqueness and spatial clustering for actual lattice gauge measures. Their SU(N) condition gives K=N/2-8(d-1) beta_repo>0 after normalizing beta_repo=N beta_paper. Thus SU(2), d=4 has beta_repo<1/24 and K=1-24 beta_repo. The Langevin-time Poincare constant is not itself the physical transfer-time gap.
primary_literature_check.normalization_status: Conversion is our algebraic inference from their displayed action and threshold. No weak-coupling extension inferred.

independent_review.scope: Natural-math geometry, tangent response, original-law proxy and strong-coupling constants
independent_review.verdict: Passed; exact 18-neighbor geometry for n>=3, inverse orientations and chord metric isometries checked. The proxy is zero at A=0 while the true unit tangent response there is beta/2. No ground-state-law or physical-transfer conclusion.
